messages:
Maya Chen: FYI research pushed a candidate model 'albatross-13b' into our model registry. Quick offline passes look promising for latency but we see small QA drops on some customer prompts. Need an intake + rollout checklist for hosted/dedicated/private. Who can drive?
Samir Patel: I can take coordination. Need to pick a quant path for initial canaries (PTQ int8 vs QAT int8 vs experimental int4). Also need canonical eval sets and regression thresholds from product.
Lucas Rivera: From infra: recommend starting with int8 PTQ on hosted canaries to reduce blast radius. For Dedicated/Private we should produce PTQ and QAT artifacts and include quantization configs. Fallback model idea: vesta-7b for cost/latency fallback.
Olivia Park: Product priorities: hosted first to measure unit economics. Acceptance criteria: 10% token-cost improvement or measurable latency gains, and QA top-500 F1 regression <= 1.5 points. Any persistent regression should block rollout.
Samir Patel: Proposed workflow:
1) Offline eval matrix across quant variants (latency, perplexity, qa_f1, hallucination rate, safety filters)
2) Hosted canary: 0.5-1% traffic for 24h with automatic rollback on thresholds
3) Ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with sampling and A/B collection
4) After hosted baseline OK, publish artifacts + docs for Dedicated/Private

Samir Patel: Running experiment command now:
```
./bench/run_all.sh --model albatross-13b --quants ptq,int8-qat,int4-exp --seq 64,128 --bench latency,qa,perplexity,safety --out /tmp/alb_evals_2026_03_18
```
Samir Patel: Upload target: s3://redwood-model-evals/albatross/sha-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)/

Lucas Rivera: Canary deploy draft for deploybot (put into deploy template):
```
{
  "model": "albatross-13b-ptq",
  "traffic_split": 0.01,
  "metrics": ["p95_latency_ms","token_cost_usd","qa_f1_top500","safety_fp_rate","error_rate"],
  "rollback_rules": {
    "p95_latency_ms": ">360",
    "qa_f1_top500": "-1.5",
    "safety_fp_rate": ">0.01",
    "error_rate": ">0.02"
  }
}
```
Lucas Rivera: Ensure fallback route -> vesta-7b; same region routing as control. Enable KV-cache warming and prefix cache seeding for common prompts.
Maya Chen: Add human-in-the-loop review at 5% stage (50 samples) and safety eval set checks. Also quantify hallucination delta metric.
Samir Patel: Adding safety set and human review to the run. I'll also generate a quant-sensitivity matrix to spot activation outliers; if PTQ fails badly we escalate to QAT.
Olivia Park: GTM asked if hosted canary can be live by next Tuesday. Any blockers? Also list private deployment tasks (air-gapped packaging, KMS/HSM docs, certs).
Samir Patel: Next Tuesday is tight but feasible if infra provides canary slot and we deliver builds by Friday EOD. Private will need an OVA + KMS integration doc and is likely +1 week from hosted baseline.
DeployBot: Deploy queued: deploy-canary/albatross-13b-ptq -> cluster-hosted-a :eyes:
sre-alerts: SRE checklist: create dashboard with panels: p50/p95 latency, req rate, GPU util, mem alloc, token cost, qa_f1 rolling 1h, safety_fp rolling 1h. Wire alerts to rollback rules and setup on-call paging for immediate investigation.
Lucas Rivera: Also add a privacy-safe sampling hook to capture inputs/outputs for 0.1% of canary requests (redact PII) for debugging and eval reproducibility.
Maya Chen: Draft acceptance checklist for sign-off:
- Offline eval artifacts uploaded and compared to baseline (Samir)
- Canary run 24h with no rollback triggers (Infra + SRE)
- Human safety review at 5% stage below thresholds (Safety/Product)
- Cost/latency targets met (Product)
- Dedicated/private build artifacts and packaging published (Packaging)
After checklist passes, perform a 72h gradual ramp and gather post-ramp sign-offs.
Olivia Park: Sounds good. @Samir post the first eval summary here when ready. @Lucas bump the thread when canary slot is confirmed.
Samir Patel: Running offline matrix now, ETA results tarball Friday 18:00 UTC. Will post S3 link and summarized metrics in this thread. :shipit:
Lucas Rivera: Canary slot reserved Monday 02:00 UTC. I updated infra playbook with GPU pool id, autoscale policy and KV-cache warmers. Will share deploy runbook in the next message.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. This thread is the single source of truth for the albatross bring-up. If you change the checklist, update this thread with the snippet. :thumbsup:
